W.note: Blurred halo visibly blooms and fades on the dark ground, with separate in (320ms lift, 700ms glow curve) and out (380ms release, 500ms glow) timings, a clear focus ring, a reduced-motion switch, and a disabled state.

X.note: The overshoot lift and drifting veil are pleasant, but the hover animates letter-spacing and background-position and the overflow:hidden clips the aura, so the glow reads mostly as a colour wash.

Y.note: The cyan sheen sweep is a nice touch but reads as a flat wash, the white label on the pink Atelier button has weak contrast, and hover animates filter and letter-spacing.

Z.note: The most complete system: 3px focus ring, reduced-motion preview, validated waitlist form with live region, and a responsive states table, though the halo is subtler and the bloom curve is a fairly ordinary ease-in-out.
